data.one_liner: Full‑stack Dart framework for building server, UI, and APIs in pure Dart
data.what_it_does: Flint Dart provides a unified framework that includes a high‑performance HTTP server, declarative web UI components, an Active Record ORM, WebSocket support, and AI runtime. It allows developers to write both backend logic and frontend UI in a single language with zero JavaScript build tools.
use_when: You need a single‑language full‑stack solution for web apps
You want server‑side rendering and SEO out of the box
You want built‑in ORM and real‑time WebSocket support
You prefer declarative UI syntax similar to Flutter
avoid_when: You only need a lightweight HTTP client or simple API server
You are building a mobile‑only app
You require extensive third‑party plugin ecosystem beyond what Flint offers
strengths: Unified pure‑Dart stack with no JS/CSS build tools
Built‑in declarative UI and SSR for SEO
Active Record ORM with migrations and tenant support
Real‑time WebSocket and AI runtime built in
weaknesses: Large monolithic package, may be overkill for small projects
Limited community and ecosystem compared to mainstream frameworks
data.setup_notes: Add dependency via `dart pub add flint_dart`, run `dart pub global activate flint_dart` for CLI, then `flint create my_app` or add to existing project. No build_runner needed.
